reviews.text: Poor Communication. I first purchased the “Pro” version in the spring of ‘25. Was incredible! Very pleased. However, upon renewing my subscription in the spring of ‘26 I noticed the mobile app wasn’t recognizing my sub. Didn’t have any of my uploads or other docs saved. I reached out to the team on the 28th of April and as of today, I’ve yet to hear back. It’s been an entire month and I haven’t been able to access any of the project I’ve created over the last year. Be mindful of that if you’re wanting to download and utilize this once incredible platform.

It’s a newer app so of course it still needs some work, I get error messages here and there, and some problems, but nothing horrible. It’s a great app overall. I think a feature where it can read out the notes or even a feature like google notebook where it can talk back to us while studying would be amazing.

Not Worth The $. I’ve had Atlas: AI for a week now and my overall opinion is it’s not worth the money. It’s essentially an unfinished product at a finished products price point. I’ve messed with the test making feature a lot, the AI is smart enough to make tests that are relevant to your topics. However there are no options on how you want the test formatted, it’s always multiple choice. I’ve tried to play with the notes and study guide options but did not like them as much. My number one problem is the ability to organize, you can make folders and then add “spaces” to them, however you cannot rearrange these spaces. If you accidentally delete a space there’s no way to get it back. I’ve also encountered some bugs where I’ve gotten a “unable to create space” message even though I paid for the upgraded version. Not thrilled with my experience given the price point.

10/10 recommend. This app is so helpful. Love that you can upload resources from class. Makes it so much easier to find information in notes. Also makes it so the information is trustworthy. Atlas also pulls in information from outside resources. I was so tired of asking chatGPT questions and getting back answers that had discrepancies. Really broke my trust with that chatCPT. Atlas AI actually takes a minute (well more like 30 seconds tops) to “think” before responding, which is much appreciated. I was getting so frustrated that chatGPT was sacrificing rapid answers with correct information. I even “told” chatGPT that I would prefer to wait a few seconds over inaccurate information, but it still provided rapid inaccurate answers often. Love and trust Atlas AI. Also, the Atlas AI app developers are very friendly and open to suggestions which has been so appreciated and helpful. Totally recommend this app for students!

I'd be screwed without Atlas. I tried a ton of other AI apps for school and even turned in homework with the answers. I got a C MINUS.

I tried Atlas this week and it's lowkey slept on. Actually gets answers right. Takes time to set up but thank god I have this for the rest of college.

reviews.text: Crashes. The free app crashes, I can’t even upload anything and then when I retry it it says it’s out of uploads until late evening the next day. Phenomenal. I’m a grade 11 student. I have severe adhd and tests, quizzes, exams, large assessments, you name it send me spiralling. This app organizes all and any of my teachers notes posted online and makes them into study guides, quizzes, q- cards, notes. The only down side is you can only do so much in a day without pro. BUT you can get pro temporary by inviting friends and it’ll give you a day of pro at a time. Pro is around 70 cad a year from what I remember without the 30% discount. Not bad to be honest and I may invest BUT HIGHLY RECOMMEND FOR ACADEMIC WEAPONS NEEDING CLARITY AND A LACK OF CLUTTER.
